candidate_merges.message: Fix AppHost tree E2E row recycling race (#20400) ## Description Fixes #20335 ExTester can recycle a tree row between lookup and `getLabel()`, causing the AppHost discovery test to read `Deploy AppHost` instead of `AspireE2E.AppHost.csproj`. Capture labels and parent/child relationships in one snapshot for read-only assertions, revalidate handle-based lookups, and add deterministic regression coverage. Production extension behavior is unchanged. ### Validation - [Full CI passed](https://github.co

This matches a known recurring timing-related flaky pattern for this fixture, not code changed by the candidate merges (Deno/npm/node app tests, DCP dependency update, and Blazor E2E stabilization).
